summary: Talladega County, AL tower in the Talladega National Forest; the NHLR describes a 100 ft Aermotor run by the USFS but gives no build date and no record after a 2022 visit.

facts.design: 100 ft Aermotor tower with a diagonal staircase (model not stated)
facts.status_note: Last dated record is the register's site visit of 5/1/22; no later condition report found

notes_for_editor: Only one register page gives facts about this tower. Two WebSearch queries found no other record; the Talladega-area names that came up (Kahatchee, Cheaha Bunker) are different towers and are not used. The Forest Lookouts Alabama index in the crawl cache does not list Kentuck. The register's 100ft figure is taken as tower height (height_m 30.5). No build date, staffing history or current access is documented, so the story says so. No photos added; the register images are already in the record. Worth a check with the Forest Service (Talladega District) on access and current condition before publishing.
